Katrina Park: Quick sync 1: lock GA criteria for Inference Gateway v1 (target Nov 15). Need final SLA, pricing SKUs, monitoring alerts, oncall rota, and public docs timeline.

Noah Kim: SLA proposal: Hosted Tier-A 99.95% uptime, Dedicated 99.98%. Latency SLOs: embeddings p95 <= 40ms, small-gen p95 <= 120ms. Also publish p50/p95 cold-starts in docs only.

Evan Zhou: Add 5xx SLO: rolling 1h < 0.1%. Fallback policy: route to quantized variant in same region; if region degraded, route to secondary region. I'll draft the fallback decision table.

Katrina Park: Pricing: 3 SKUs (dev, standard, enterprise). Standard: steady QPS 120, burst 400 for 30s then throttle. Enterprise: reserved throughput + SLA. docs-bot, stub public pricing examples?

docs-bot: Pricing draft created in staging. Example calc: 1M tokens/month on Standard -> approx $X. Will update with final QPS numbers.

Noah Kim: Monitoring alerts for GA runbook: sustained p95 breach >5m, error-rate >0.5% over 5m, GPU util >90% for 10m, cache-hit drop >15%. Map each alert to a PagerDuty escalation and runbook step.

ops-bot: Created "IGW GA oncall" rota stub; provisional owners: Evan, Noah, +1. Runbook stub published at /runbooks/igw-ga. Smoke window scheduled Nov 14 02:00-03:00 UTC.

Katrina Park: Owners recap: SLA (Noah), fallback + runbook (Evan), pricing + public docs (docs-bot), monitoring -> PD (Noah). Meet Wed 10:00 PT for final signoff. React :white_check_mark: when green or flag blockers now.

Evan Zhou: :white_check_mark: runbook + fallback (PR incoming).

Noah Kim: :white_check_mark: SLA + alerts (will push dashboard PR today).

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: pricing draft staged; will promote after numbers locked.

Katrina Park: Thanks team. If anything changes, post here before Wed runbook review.
